purpose: Minimal reference panel used to validate the lane before candidate design.

rows.label: primary_positive
rows.hypothesis: Should recover the intended pocket or target surface better than negatives.

rows.label: secondary_positive
rows.hypothesis: Should behave plausibly but not necessarily as strongly as the primary positive.

rows.label: scrambled_positive
rows.hypothesis: Composition-preserving scramble should not behave like the real binder.

rows.label: poly_ala_control
rows.hypothesis: Composition floor should fail geometry and specificity.
